MISSOURI WITH SLING TV#7 Miami vs. #10 Missouri Prediction, Odds, & How to Watch: March Madness® 2026#7 Miami faces #10 Missouri at the Enterprise Center ina crucial West Region battle. Here are details, our prediction, and how to watch with Sling TV.The No. 7 seed Miami Hurricanes (25-8) and No. 10 seed Missouri Tigers (20-12) face off in a first-round March Madness® clash that many consider a toss-up. Under first-year head coach Jai Lucas, Miami turned a 7-24 season into a top-tier NCAA Tournament entry, highlighted by first-team All-ACC forward Malik Reneau. They meet a Missouri squad that, despite a three-game losing streak, lands in a favorable position playing in its home state in St. Louis.To Watch the Hurricanes vs. Tigers First Round game with Sling, use the link below for a 1 Day Pass subscription to truTV and add the Entertainment Extras pack.Game DetailInformationMatchup#7 Miami vs. #10 MissouriDate/TimeFriday, March 20, 2026 at 10:10 PM ETLocationEnterprise Center, St. Louis, MOChanneltruTVWatch With Sling1, 3, & 7 Day Pass + Entertainment Extras or a monthlysubscription to Sling Blue.Opening SpreadMiami -1.5 to -2.5 (O/U 147.5 to 150.5)Miami Hurricanes Analysis Season Overview: Miami finished 25-8 overall (13-5 in ACC), securing marquee ranked wins over North Carolina and Louisville during a resurgent season. Star Player: Malik Reneau (F). The first-team All-ACC selection anchors the Hurricanes, leading the team in scoring with 18.8 PPG while adding 6.6 RPG. The X-Factor: Three-Point Defense. The Hurricanes have struggled to contain the long ball all season, ranking in the 270s nationally in three-point percentage defense—a vulnerability that could be costly in March. Missouri Tigers Analysis Season Overview: Missouri (20-12) earned an at-large bid after banking quality conference wins against Kentucky, Tennessee, and Florida, though they enter the tournament having lost five of their last eight games. Star Player: Mark Mitchell (F). A centerpiece of the offense, Mitchell averages 13.9 PPG and provides a physical interior presence capable of matching up with Miami's frontcourt. The Upset Formula: St. Louis Advantage. The selection committee's decision to place the Tigers in St. Louis effectively gives the #10 seed a home-court environment, which could prove decisive in a close matchup. Key Matchup & Advanced Analytics Position Battle: Interior Physicality. Malik Reneau vs. Missouri's frontcourt. The Tigers have the defensive size to potentially disrupt Reneau, but they must also handle Miami's glass dominance. Statistical Edge: Miami finished first in the ACC in field-goal percentage (50.1%) and second in rebound differential (+7.4), while Missouri features a top-40 offense in adjusted efficiency. Betting Trends: Miami opened as a narrow 1.5 to 2.5-point favorite, but many analysts are backing Missouri to win straight up given the geographic advantage. Final Prediction & Betting Pick The Verdict: Missouri Tigers. Final Score Prediction: Missouri 72, Miami 70. Best Bet: Missouri ML (+112).
